caption: The video captures a small fire burning in a rectangular silver aluminum tray, against a dark green wall of horizontal wooden slats on the left and a blurred brick wall with a potted plant on the right. The camera stays stationary, so the tray and background hold fixed positions while only the flame changes. At the start the fire already flares with several bright tongues, including a tall plume leaning upward and to the right above the bushier base. Over time the flames flicker, shifting shape and height as the tall rightward tongue thins and the lower body swells into a rounder cluster. Small detached fragments occasionally rise and separate from the main plume, drifting briefly near the top before vanishing. The light cast on the metallic surface of the tray fluctuates as the overall intensity waxes and wanes. The combustion continues throughout, the tray and walls unchanged behind the restless glow.
